en-US.name: Namma-Kanakku
en-US.shortDescription: A voice khata that learns your shop's language, keeps debts private, and never guesses with money.
en-US.fullDescription: Namma-Kanakku turns Alexa+ into an intelligent voice khata for local neighbourhood kirana stores. It understands mixed Indian languages (English, Tamil words, Tanglish) without an external LLM, deterministically matching products, calculating loose-item weights, and maintaining customer credit ledgers. It strictly respects privacy: customer debt balances and limit statuses are never announced aloud in earshot of other customers, appearing only on screen. Every successful entry provides an immediate itemized total with a spoken undo safety prompt. Shopkeepers can teach custom vocabulary, update prices by voice, and review 30-day overdue accounts.
examplePhrases: Alexa, log 1 curd and half kilo toor dal for Ramesh tab
Alexa, what is Ramesh Teacher's current balance?
Alexa, record payment of 50 rupees from Ramesh Teacher
